text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position in first sentence","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its argument up front so the reader immediately knows the writer’s stance."},{"evidence":"more developed reasons about accidents, confusion, and liability","quality":"support development","description":"The essay gives several distinct reasons that build and extend its case against driverless cars."},{"evidence":"“whose fault will it be… the driver or the manufacturer?”","quality":"use of source-based evidence","description":"The essay grounds its argument in a specific issue raised by the article rather than relying only on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"“What if…? / Let’s be honest…”","quality":"persuasive engagement","description":"The essay uses direct, rhetorical language to press the reader and make the argument feel more forceful."},{"evidence":"“could also lead to the manufacturers getting sued”","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"The essay shows some awareness of the practical consequences and blame conflict that could follow from its claim."}]}
